title: Install Floatlet
lead: Run Floatlet.exe on Windows 11, install with startup, connect Google Calendar subscriptions and learn the island controls.
html:
Run the EXE directly

The main download is Floatlet.exe. Save it in a folder you want to keep, then run it. This standalone download does not install itself or create a startup entry. For startup and a managed installation, use the ZIP below.

Install with startup

Choose ZIP with installation scripts on the download page and extract it into a folder. The archive contains Floatlet.exe, the MIT license, release notes and installation scripts.

Try it without installing

Run Floatlet.exe from the extracted folder. The app appears above your desktop and in the Windows system tray, without a taskbar or Alt+Tab entry.

Install for your Windows user

Open PowerShell in the extracted folder and run:

.\install.ps1 -AcceptDefaults -Launch

New installs start with Windows by default. On an upgrade, pass -EnableStartup to explicitly enable startup. Add -NoStartup to opt out. Existing installations keep their startup preference. If Windows blocks a script, inspect it and follow your organisation's approved software policy. Do not disable security features.

Find your way around

  • Hover for a compact preview, then click to open.
  • Music, Tray, Controls and Clock live inside the expanded island.
  • Leave an unpinned panel to return to the compact view. Pin preserves the panel.
  • The gear opens preferences. Right-click or the system tray menu offers more actions.
  • Ctrl+Shift+F12 opens and Ctrl+Alt+H hides or shows, when those shortcuts are available. Conflicts are handled silently.

Optional Google Calendar

In Google Calendar, find your calendar's Settings, then Integrate calendar, then Secret address in iCal format. Paste it directly into Floatlet's Preferences. Treat this address as a password. Do not send it in an issue or screenshot.

Double-click a day for its read-only agenda. Windows DPAPI encrypts the stored subscription link for your user.

Calendar reminders

Open Preferences, Connect Google Calendar, then follow the three steps. The link is private and stays encrypted for your Windows user. The feed refreshes about once per minute while Floatlet is running. Timed events trigger a pop-out reminder within five minutes of their start. Google may take longer to publish edits into its subscription feed. All-day events do not trigger five-minute reminders.

Multiple calendars

In Preferences, open Google Calendar. Paste a private Google iCal link and choose Add calendar. Repeat for up to eight calendars, then Save. Select a saved calendar and choose Remove selected, then Save, to disconnect it. Their events share one chronological agenda with duplicate occurrences filtered out. Healthy calendars continue syncing if another feed is unavailable.

Choose what appears

Open the gear inside Floatlet. Show calls controls microphone activity visibility and monitoring. Icon-only music keeps the resting capsule smaller, and Reduce motion limits animations. For supported call apps, Open call app brings their native controls forward.

title: Uninstall Floatlet
html:
Remove the installed app

Quit Floatlet from its system tray menu. Open its installation folder and run uninstall.ps1 in PowerShell. New installations use %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Floatlet. Upgrades can retain the previous installation folder to preserve Windows startup preferences.

The uninstaller removes the owned executable, shortcut and matching startup entry. It refuses to run from an unrelated folder.

What stays on your computer

Settings, tray references and the encrypted calendar subscription are retained. The compatibility data folder is %LOCALAPPDATA%\DelightIsland. This internal identifier is retained so existing users do not lose data during the rename.

Disconnect the calendar in preferences to remove the stored subscription. If you choose to remove the compatibility data folder manually after quitting, back up anything you want to keep first. Original files referenced by the tray are never deleted by the uninstaller.

Portable use

Quit the app, then remove its extracted folder. Local settings are retained just as they are with an installed copy.

title: What Floatlet can do
lead: Check music, file tray, clocks, calendar sync, call controls and display support, with clear release and hardware limitations.
html:
Available in the Windows preview

  • Windows media-session metadata, artwork and advertised playback controls.
  • File references, incoming drop, outgoing copy drag and reference removal.
  • Recent saved screenshot references. Clipboard-only screenshots are not archived.
  • Volume and mute. Internal display brightness when Windows WMI supports it.
  • Nearby Wi-Fi and connections through saved profiles. New credentials use Windows.
  • Persistent timer and alarm alerts, stopwatch, five-minute calendar reminders, interactive month calendar and up to eight optional read-only Google Calendar subscriptions.
  • Microphone activity for selected apps, one endpoint mute control, Open call app and the Show calls preference. This does not identify the other caller or provide Discord deafen or hang-up.
  • Per-monitor DPI and pointer following, with a pin option and reduced motion preference.

Not implemented

Caller photos, answering and hanging up, AirPods battery values, a native ARM64 release and external monitor DDC/CI brightness. Night light, Bluetooth pairing, projection and energy saver open Windows interfaces.

What has been checked

The 0.6.3 Windows build passed model, storage, integration, calendar and clock suites. The previous build passed real-window checks across the connected displays. Calendar parsing uses synthetic events; no personal feed was supplied for account validation.

Performance, without a promise

Two short observations of 0.3.0 measured 0.199% and 0.5681% total-machine CPU, and 46.58 and 123.93 MiB private memory. Playback and pointer activity were uncontrolled. These are historical observations, not current-release benchmarks, idle guarantees or proof of battery savings.

Read the validation record. GPU activity, battery drain, complete accessibility and 120 Hz frame pacing remain unverified.

Development preview, separate from the public download

Search and minimize-to-edge refinements are being developed. Search combines apps, indexed files, windows and commands. Its latest design uses DirectWrite text and follows the pointer between displays. A catalogue fallback for song artwork is also in development. These changes are not part of 0.6.3.

Read the Search guide and release status.

title: What is new
html:
In development: Search and desktop refinements

Alt+Space Search, app-first results, file collection, a redesigned native search interface, minimize-to-edge behaviour and Apple Music artwork fallback are under development. They are not included in the 0.6.3 download. The latest design has passed automated and local desktop visual checks. Live pointer-following across multiple monitors still needs verification.

0.6.3: Clearer call controls

One mute control, a headset icon and a persistent Show calls switch. Turn it off to hide microphone activity and stop monitoring. Open call app brings forward native call controls. Direct participant names, deafen and hang-up are not implemented.

0.6.2: Calendar connection feedback

Rejected subscription links show a connection error instead of an apparently empty synced day. Private Google calendars need the Secret iCal address.

0.6.1: Multiple calendars and app icons

Connect up to eight Google Calendar subscriptions with encrypted local storage, a merged agenda and duplicate filtering. Media without artwork can use the Windows app icon, with a music-note fallback.

0.6.0: Persistent alerts and reminders

Wider icon-only music, shaking alarm-clock icons, camera notifications, and alerts that stop only when you press Dismiss inside Clock. Google subscriptions refresh every minute and show upcoming-event reminders. Open Floatlet with Ctrl+Shift+F12. Main downloads now provide the standalone EXE.

0.5.0: Clocks and quiet motion

A running stopwatch stays in the compact pill. Timer completion and alarms expand with a dismissible chime. Music uses a small, softly smoothed waveform with a fixed maximum height. Hover playback targets are larger. Settings include the creator credit.

0.4.0 · Floatlet

The app, executable, shortcuts and public project now use Floatlet. Existing settings, calendar subscription and startup preferences are preserved. Idle is a compact unlabelled pill. Shortcut conflicts no longer interrupt startup.

0.3.0

Introduced quick timers, nearby Wi-Fi, preferences inside the island, calendar subscriptions, microphone activity controls and rendering reuse.

Read complete release notes on GitHub.

title: Privacy at Floatlet
lead: Know what stays, and what leaves.
html:
Preview notice. Optional tracking is disabled. Operator contact details, hosting retention and the final public privacy notice still require owner confirmation before a production launch.

This website

The interactive preview uses invented track and file data. It does not read your media sessions, accept real files, change Windows settings or access your calendar. No account, upload form or website database is included.

Your optional privacy choice is stored in this browser as floatlet-privacy, with a policy version and timestamp. The site asks again after 180 days or a policy-version change. If storage is unavailable, it continues without remembering the choice.

Optional measurement

Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity are not configured in this preview. No scripts or measurement requests are sent to those services. Accepting a choice does not enable an unconfigured integration. Downloads remain available after rejection.

If enabled in a future reviewed release, usage analytics and masked session replay require separate opt-in. Download clicks would measure intent, not installations. Use Privacy settings in the footer to change or withdraw your choice.

Hosting and downloads

A deployed website's hosting provider processes network requests to serve it. This website is hosted by Vercel. Its infrastructure handles IP addresses and request information to serve and secure pages. See Vercel's privacy policy for its practices; this project does not assert a specific hosting-log retention period. GitHub serves downloads and issues under its own policies. This page does not claim that those services collect no data.

The Windows app

Settings and file references stay in the local compatibility data folder. The optional Google Calendar address is encrypted with Windows DPAPI; events are fetched directly from Google over HTTPS and cached in memory. The app reads microphone session metadata, not audio samples. It does not record calls or copy messages.

Uninstall retains settings and the encrypted subscription. Disconnecting the calendar removes its saved link. Tray reference removal leaves original files intact.

Before public launch

The maintainer must confirm the privacy contact, processing responsibilities, applicable legal bases, transfers, retention, rights and complaint route. This preview is not a substitute for that completed notice. Do not post personal calendar links or sensitive information in public issues.

Artwork lookup in the development build

The development build can send the current track title and artist to Apple's catalogue when browser or Apple Music artwork is missing, and download a matching cover from Apple's artwork servers. This is not in the 0.6.3 public download. Search queries remain local.

title: Help with Floatlet
html:
Report a bug

Open an issue on GitHub. Include your Windows version, app version, display scaling and steps to reproduce. Do not include private calendar addresses, personal screenshots or files.

Security concerns

Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting instead of a public issue for sensitive reports.

Contribute

Fork the MIT-licensed source and propose a focused change. The repository requires code-owner review and a passing Windows build for outside contributions. Maintained by Mithil Katkoria. Response times are not guaranteed.

title: Floatlet Search for Windows
lead: An Alt+Space app and file launcher in development. See how Search works, what it needs and what is available today.
html:
Development preview. Search is not included in the current 0.6.3 public download.

One shortcut for apps, files and commands

Floatlet Search opens with Alt+Space when that shortcut is available. Type an app name, a file name or a containing folder. Matching applications rank above file and folder results. Existing windows and Floatlet commands can also appear.

What provides file results?

Everything is the primary indexed-file provider. Floatlet uses its local IPC interface and does not build a second drive index. When Everything is absent, a bounded Windows Search query can cover indexed locations. Unindexed files are not found by crawling the disk.

Keep useful files close

  • Enter opens the selected result.
  • Shift+Enter adds a file reference to Floatlet and closes Search.
  • Ctrl+Enter collects a reference and keeps Search open.
  • Tab opens actions including Reveal in File Explorer, Copy file and Copy path.
  • Escape closes Search.

What if I already use Flow Launcher?

Floatlet does not take a registered shortcut from another app. If Flow Launcher owns Alt+Space, choose another shortcut in Floatlet Search preferences or use the island's context menu. You can also disable Search.

Multiple monitors and accessibility

The new design places Search in the active pointer's display work area and scales it for that screen. It follows a stable pointer move while open, except during a drag or action menu. Reduced motion and Windows high contrast are supported in code. The latest redesign has been visually checked locally. Live pointer-following across multiple monitors still needs verification before release.

What stays private?

Search queries and search history are not sent to a server or saved to disk. The worker waits when there is no request, cancels obsolete results and uses bounded in-memory caches. The website demo uses invented results and never searches your computer.
